purpose.heading: Our purpose
purpose.subheading: Trusted systems for Nigerian schools and SMEs

image.alt: Hyperion Tech Hub Purpose - Schools and SMEs

paragraphs: Hyperion Tech Hub is Abuja’s digital partner for schools and growing SMEs. We build systems you can run day-to-day — fees, results, orders, staff portals — then we host, train your team, and stay on as a retainer partner.

Our focus is deliberate: Education systems (EduSuite), SME digital kits, managed Hyperion Care retainers, and skills training. Walk-in repairs and printing keep the hub useful locally without diluting what we stand for.
Trust is earned with named work we still support — not vanity client counts. Every logo on our portfolio is a client you can call and a system we maintain.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: Build and maintain EduSuite, SME kits, and client systems on Next.js and related stacks.
responsibilities: Design and develop scalable web applications
Participate in code reviews and architecture decisions
requirements: Strong experience with React, Node.js, and TypeScript
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Design clear experiences for school admins, parents, and SME operators.
responsibilities: Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
Conduct user research and usability testing
Collaborate with developers to implement designs
Maintain design systems and style guides
requirements: Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch

jobs.title: Client Success / Support Lead
jobs.description: Own Hyperion Care retainers, school onboarding, and SME go-live support.
responsibilities: Run onboarding for EduSuite and SME Kit clients
Manage retainer SLAs and quarterly reviews
Escalate technical issues with clear tickets
requirements: Comfort with school or SME operations
Basic familiarity with web hosting and payments
